RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of discrimination. In healthcare administration, female leadership is common. For the head of a laboratory, management qualifications and broad leadership experience are frequently weighted more heavily than purely academic credentials, such as a PhD over a master's degree.

Raising sex bias without concrete proof—such as discriminatory remarks or documented procedural breaches—will appear unprofessional and could damage your reputation. A two-week delay for written feedback is also standard bureaucratic HR timing, not an admission of impropriety. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused on how you can better demonstrate executive leadership for future department head opportunities.
